issue.title: Chop batch cancellation leaves dispatching members live after generation cancellation
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** `tests/axe/test_axe_chop_batch_replay.py::test_clan_cancellation_during_launch_settles_current_and_stops_next`

The companion `tests/axe/test_axe_chop_batch_store.py::test_cancellation_priority_and_reconcile_selection` also fails on serial rerun. The cancellation event leaves a member in `dispatching`, and replay does not raise after the generation is canceled. Observed at HEAD `fc0abbd54c286f1dcf285bf1f717418ce9e3257b`; both failed in the broad check and in a serial rerun.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Both chop-batch cancellation tests failed in the broad check and reproduced serially on the unchanged tree: a canceled batch retained a dispatching member and the replay callback did not raise.

issue.creation_reason: The required check reported two chop-batch cancellation tests failing, and both reproduced serially on the same tree. The failures are outside the video-preview files and need independent follow-up.
